next.reason: 1985: 'If more than one COBOL library is available to the compiler during compilation, text-name must be qualified each time it is referenced.'; 2023: "Only 'Within one COBOL library, each text-name shall be unique.'; 8.4.2.2.3 lists no text-name qualification rule". 2023 still covers COPY text-name uniqueness and qualification but no longer requires text-name to be qualified when several libraries are available.
